Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

Attacks starting from Upgrade 8 are able to hit flying enemies.

Selling

Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

Trivia

  • Starting from upgrade 8, Guts becomes hybrid and can hit air enemies
  • Berserker (Rage) bleed damage is 25% of his damage (when paired with Bloodcry (Fallen) or Blood (Unleashed) his bleed does 125% of his total damage)
  • At base max upgrade, the combined damage per second ( DPS ) with his bleed is 28,375.25 (Stats may vary)
  • Berserker (Rage) "Dragonslayer Assault" attack has the fourth highest multi-hit count in the entire game, only being topped by Boxer and Mimic Sorcerer (Cursed Child) at 7 Hits and Ghost-kun (Bound) at 9 Hits!
  • On Guts "Beast of Darkness" attack, bleed is applied on the second hit rather than the first. This is mainly due to the fact that Berserker (Rage) is missing one of his eyes and can not properly aim.
